modules.scope: Hilbert complex complete, selfadjoint A/B, bounded intertwiner R. Compact union of spectra allows complex CFC induction, including star-id via selfadjointness. U transport extends from dense damping range of Q; both endpoint injectivities explicit. R need not be invertible.

F_r(x)=x/(r+(1-r)x), e_r=r/(r+(1-r)x)^2. Denominator positive on [0,1] for r>0. Endpoints handled separately, logarithm multiplication only off endpoints. Phase convention +it log r retained, no numeric r.

Spectrum of positive contraction lies in [0,1]. CFC nonzero denominator and spectrum-continuity are proved, not assumed globally near poles. E_r is a bounded unit by nonvanishing CFC, not an inverse of damping. B_Q=B_T E_r and C_Q=e^(it log r) C_T E_r use the same r,T.
Range of B_Q contains range B_T because E_r is surjective; dense-range cancellation gives U_T R=e^(it log r) R U_T on all H. No inverse of R or bounded inverse of B_T.

Matrix-unit ratio localEigenvalue>0 and resolvent-right-scaling are consumed. Regular right group commutes via its previous resolvent identity. No transport of the entire left algebra claimed.

J is conjugate-semilinear isometry equivalence; generic proof does not assume J involutive. Conjugation is real star-algebra hom, conjugates complex scalars. Real CFC plus real/imag decomposition yields conjugated complex CFC. star(g_t(1-x))=g_t(x), so C_t and B_T invariant. Dense range yields JU_t=U_tJ; same t, not -t.
